description: Rewards from deterministically solving secret notes. mailFlag is the key written to mailReceived in the save file when the reward is claimed — confirmed from real save files. Notes with no mailFlag have no trackable one-time reward. Hand-curated from https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Secret_Notes.

rewards.note: Reach level 100 of the Skull Cavern to encounter Mr. Qi
Interact with the bush above the playground at noon on day 28 of any season
Mermaid show at the Night Market — click shells in order 1-5-4-2-3
Dig the tile right of the boulder north of Railroad tracks
Dig the farthest north tile on the east side of the river north of JojaMart
Dig southwest of the bench in the southeast Calico Desert (not during Desert Festival)
Follow the arrows from 1 Willow Lane to the tile behind Mayor Lewis' house and right-click to dig it up
Trade a Rabbit's Foot to the truck driver parked beside JojaMart
Interact with the bush northwest of the bridge to The Beach at 12:40am
Place a battery in the fuse box in the tunnel to begin the Mysterious Qi quest
Bring Maple Syrup to the bear in the Secret Woods to receive Bear's Knowledge (triples sell price of Blackberries and Salmonberries)
